- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py (and workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py twin): lines 134-136 (DISPATCHED_REVIEW_WORKFLOW / DISPATCHED_REVIEW_TITLE / DISPATCHED_REVIEW_RUNS_PATH), line 301, line 333, line 335
  PROBLEM: The PR-named dispatch-run lookup in `_active_run_count` and the validation in `_is_pr_dispatched_review_run` are hardcoded for `internal-review.yml` and its title `"Internal: AI Review & Autofix [pr:{number}]"`. Consumer repos use `ai-review.yml` with run name `"AI Review [pr:<N>]"`. The twin file is byte-identical, so consumer repos receive these same constants. In consumer repos, `_active_run_count`'s PR-named fallback queries `internal-review.yml/runs` which 404s (handled, returns 0), so the checker never sees active `ai-review.yml` dispatch runs; `_is_pr_dispatched_review_run` rejects `ai-review.yml` runs because both the workflow path and title checks fail. After #4701 moved consumer-repo dispatches to the default branch, the head-branch lookup and `head_branch == head_ref` check no longer find or accept them.
  WHY: In a consumer repo with a `claude/*` PR, the poller dispatches `ai-review.yml` from the default branch (issue #4701). The §26 checker runs `check_in_status.py --hand-back`; `_active_run_count` finds nothing on the head branch, falls through to the PR-named lookup, gets a 404 on `internal-review.yml`, returns 0, and the checker reports `stuck` or `conflict` while a review is still running. For a review hand-off, `_check_claude_fixer_pr` reads the referenced run, `_is_pr_dispatched_review_run` rejects it, and the fallback `head_branch != head_ref` also fails, so the checker waits indefinitely for a verified completed review run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
